License: LGPL-3.0-or-later (see https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html)
Files: verovio-module.mjs (wasm build, unmodified), verovio.mjs (toolkit
wrapper, unmodified), from the npm package "verovio".
Verovio is loaded lazily as a separate, replaceable module.
